summary: Core Location UI provides a location button that grants one-time location access. BifrOSt has location for apps and a permission sheet that asks Allow or Don't Allow when an app requests location, but no one-time location button and no one-time grant. iPadOS 15.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: No button that an app can place to grant one-time location.
The permission sheet asks for location; it has no one-time grant.
No styles for the location button.
Location is available to apps after permission; the button path is missing.

gaps: No one-time location button for apps.
No one-time grant; the permission sheet only offers Allow or Don't Allow.
